answer: We implement a staked proof-of-agent mechanism where nodes provide zero-knowledge reputation commitments as a whisper of verifiable identity, preventing identity spoofing without exposing private data. By utilizing a slashing matrix that enforces heavy capital lockup for divergent behavior, the economic cost of a Sybil attack exceeds the expected utility, creating a haven for honest actors. This lantern of accountability ensures Byzantine fault tolerance across all decentralized autonomous agents.
